name: Omar Sharaf
headline: Director, Pricing Model Engineering & MLOps
summary: Director of Pricing Model Engineering and MLOps with {years}+ years at Fortune 100 insurance and healthcare companies, taking actuarial and data science models into governed, production-grade deployment. Leads the high-performing engineering teams behind them, doubling the number of models in production and delivering four Generative AI applications to production in 18 months.

experience.title: Director of Data Engineering — Pricing Model Support
bullets: Partner with key stakeholders, data scientists, and actuaries to build the roadmap for model deployments, serving as their trusted engineering partner and coaching engineers across lines of business to raise engineering standards.
Established governed, production-grade delivery within two weeks on an inherited team with no testing or release controls: CI/CD pipelines, code-quality gates, and production-release controls.
Hired four engineers directly and lead a team of five; onboarded and upskilled the team on AI-native development with Claude and related tools.
Cut a critical production job from up to 8 hours to 30 minutes, turning chronically missed SLAs into consistently met ones.
Reduced an 11-hour model run to 1 hour 40 minutes, letting the business run models and make decisions during the workday instead of overnight.
Converted a data scientist's prototype into production-grade code in under 24 hours using Claude Code, validated and approved by data science.
Introduced Agile sprints and act as product owner, defining epics and features with the business while staying hands-on in code.

experience.title: Technical Engineering Manager — Gen AI / MLOps
bullets: Led four teams spanning data products, AI intake pipelines, and Gen AI applications: 11 direct reports, 3 borrowed engineers embedded on the team, and about 8 offshore developers reporting into those teams. Owned delivery, performance reviews, and technical direction after a leadership transition.
Doubled the number of ML models in production, clearing the full pricing backlog until data science had no models left to deploy.
Built reusable deployment patterns that cut model-to-production time to under 24 hours with no added headcount.
Delivered four Gen AI applications to production in 18 months across RAG and AI intake use cases, including the company's first Gen AI application released to external brokers.
Served on the hiring panel that selected 10–15 high-performing engineers.
Drove adoption of GitHub Copilot and early AI tooling, improving team efficiency and engineers' technical depth.

experience.title: Cloud Data Engineer — Gen AI / MLOps
bullets: Led development and deployment of real-time and batch machine-learning models on the company's MLOps platform, ensuring scalability and reliability.
Orchestrated production deployments of models using Terraform and Airflow, keeping releases stable across environments.
Designed and implemented monitoring for deployed ML models to detect and resolve issues proactively.
Served as lead developer on the company's first RAG application, built on GPT-3.5.
Partnered with business stakeholders to set technical priorities and translate business requirements into technical roadmaps.
Mentored junior engineers on MLOps practices, Python development, and cloud architecture, and streamlined onboarding for permanent and contract hires.

experience.title: Data Engineer
bullets: Built a Python tool that converts SQL Server table DDLs into the SQL of any target platform (Snowflake, Databricks, and others) and detects schema changes in SQL Server, applying them to the target automatically, so data could live in both places and stay in sync without manual migration work.
Developed a Neo4j-backed API and web frontend that visualizes database hierarchy and improves data visibility for engineering teams.
Created an automated testing framework and set Snowflake deployment standards across the line of business.
Stepped in as interim lead for two teams during a leadership transition.

experience.title: Data Engineer
bullets: Designed Python automation tools and frameworks that shortened development cycles and saved hundreds of engineering hours annually.
Built ETL procedures that extract and transform base-table data for downstream applications, enforcing database development standards.

Developer on a system-migration project, integrating a new upstream data feed into the warehouse: used Airflow to automate moving on-prem data, joining it with cloud data, and loading it into Teradata Vantage, so downstream customers kept receiving data in the exact same formats with no visible change.
Delivered incrementally in SAFe Agile teams.

experience.title: Programmer Analyst
bullets: Built Python REST APIs serving data from Hadoop, Teradata, and Oracle, and delivered business-critical reporting through Hadoop ELT and Tableau.
Developed Angular applications in Docker containers and maintained their CI/CD pipelines.
